name: Kokoro Neural TTS Synthesis Wrapper
purpose: Verified wrapper script invoking local Kokoro 0.9.4 neural speech synthesis, handling generator return types cleanly.
capabilities: 24 kHz mono PCM WAV speech generation
Multi-persona voice selection (am_adam, af_bella, am_michael, etc.)

compatibility.notes: Requires kokoro and torch in Python 3.12 environment.

licensing.notes: Internal workspace python wrapper over Apache-2.0 Kokoro engine.

security.notes: Offline local model inference; zero external network requests.

approval_evidence: Production certified in Stage 3 speech synthesis pipeline.
